nodes.title: prompt style examples
widgets_values:
A middle-aged white man is working in a woodworking workshop. Positioned at the center of the frame, he wears a yellow and black checkered shirt with blue jeans and glasses, his graying hair neatly combed. He stands before a workbench cluttered with wooden boards and tools, holding a measuring tape in his left hand and a pen in his right, intently marking measurements on the wood. His expression is serious and focused, exuding professionalism and dedication. The background features various woodworking machinery and stacks of lumber, creating an atmosphere of diligence and precision.

A medical worker is washing his hands in the video. Positioned on the left side of the frame, he wears a light blue surgical gown, dark pants, and a blue surgical cap, with his back to the camera. He stands at a stainless steel handwashing station, facing the left side of the image, bending over the sink to wash his hands before straightening up and moving toward the center. The man first pulls the faucet lever with his right hand, then rubs his hands together while leaning slightly forward. Next, he presses the soap dispenser button with his right hand to lather his hands, ensuring thorough cleaning. After finishing, he moves toward the paper towel dispenser at the center of the frame, using it to dry his hands. In the background, white tiled walls are visible, along with a stainless steel soap dispenser and hand dryer mounted on the wall. A door can be seen in the distance on the right side of the hallway. The entire scene conveys a clean, professional, and hygienic atmosphere.

nodes.title: stage 1 - video caption prompt
reference caption instruction
widgets_values:
Describe the visible reference character in one concise paragraph: hair, facial features, skin tone, general build, visible outfit and accessories, expression and distinguishing marks. Describe the fully clothed appearance accurately; do not guess a name, exact age, pose, gesture or action.
Then output a second paragraph beginning with "BACKGROUND: " describing only the visible setting, surfaces, objects and lighting. If the background cannot be identified, say so without inventing details. Output only these two paragraphs.

nodes.title: stage 3 - final prompt template
stage 3 - final prompt template
segment caption instruction  (shared by both chunks)
widgets_values:
Describe only the visible action and clothing continuity within this segment of a driving video. Output exactly two labelled paragraphs:
ACTION: movements in chronological order, timing, body turns, weight shifts, arm and hand movement, camera framing and camera movement. Include only what happens within these frames.
STATE: the visible fully clothed outfit and its continuity at the start and end. Name garments by generic type rather than colour, material or brand because the reference outfit is used downstream. If unchanged, state that once. Do not invent garment removal or wardrobe changes.
Do not describe the setting, lighting, identity or facial traits. The image contains eight chronological frames arranged in a 4x2 grid; read left to right then top to bottom. Treat them as a continuous shot, without mentioning the grid. Output only ACTION and STATE.
